The Problem

The Home Shouldn’t Be a Battleground

In a world that celebrates hustle, parents are stretched thin. Shouting, unresolved conflict, and emotional unavailability quietly distort a child’s sense of safety — not out of malice, but out of exhaustion and lack of tools.

“We don’t raise monsters on purpose. We raise them by accident when we fail to manage ourselves.”

Founder & Chairperson
Vusumzi Mthembu
Scriptwriting and Media · Author · Artisan
Who We Are

A South African non-profit company dedicated to redefining what it means to raise the next generation. Founded by Vusumzi Morris Mthembu — husband, father, author, and qualified artisan — our work is personal. It begins at home and ripples outward into communities across KwaZulu-Natal.

We don’t come with judgment. We come with tools, community, and a deep belief that every parent who shows up is capable of change.

🛡
Shield Children From Conflict

Tiny ears weren’t built for adult wars. We help parents protect their children’s emotional space.

🤝
Replace Reaction With Connection

Modeling self-control so children learn peace rather than rage as a default response.

⌛
Presence Over Presents

Swapping guilt-driven gifts for intentional time that builds a lasting legacy.

Common Questions

We’ve Got Answers

Are your workshops really free?+

Yes — all community support circles are completely free to attend. Some specialised workshops may have a nominal fee to cover venue costs, but no parent is ever turned away for inability to pay.

Do I need to be a Christian to join?+

Absolutely not. While our foundation is faith-inspired, our programs welcome all parents regardless of religion, background, or belief. Every family deserves support.

How do I order the book?+

Contact us directly via phone or email and we will arrange delivery or collection from Pinetown. Books are available for individuals, schools, churches, and community organisations.

I’m a single parent — are there programmes for me?+

Yes. We run dedicated single-parent evenings and our support circles are specifically designed to include and uplift single parents who carry an enormous daily load.

Can organisations partner with the Foundation?+

We warmly welcome partnerships with schools, churches, corporates and NGOs. Contact us to explore how we can bring our workshops and resources to your community.

Is my donation tax-deductible?+

We are a registered South African non-profit company and are in the process of obtaining Section 18A status. We will notify all donors once tax certificates are available.
